name: Isekai Musume Hatsujouchuu ~Ore no Are o Hamu Hamu Shimakuri!?~
original_name: 異世界娘発情中～俺のアレをハムハムしまくり!?～
source: Another world has merged with our own. Elves, beastfolk, and demons now inhabit our world. Kousuke has decided to search for a bride when he meets with Chlorolud, a demon girl who tells him that he's special. He has the power to become the new demon king! With the magic powers bestowed to him he sets out to seduce the girls of the other world. Create tentacles, turn your body into a slime, summon insects that are an extension of yourself, become the demon king and use all your powers to give the heroines the ultimate pleasure. Or keep your humanity and enjoy the sweet and beautiful bodies of girls from another world.
translation: 另一个世界与我们的世界融合了。精灵、兽人和恶魔，如今都生活在我们的世界里。决心寻找新娘的康介，遇到了一名叫克萝萝乌露德的恶魔少女。她告诉康介，他是特别的——他拥有成为新魔王的力量！得到魔力后，他踏上了诱惑异世界少女们的旅途。创造触手、将身体化作史莱姆、召唤如同自身延伸的虫群，成为魔王，施展一切力量，为女主角们带来极致的快感。或者，保留自己的人性，尽情享受异世界少女们甜美而动人的身体。
